# Kenney assets

Creator: Kenney — https://kenney.nl
License: CC0. Original License.txt retained in each pack directory.

Imported subset of user-provided archives:
- Impact Sounds: light/heavy metal, heavy/medium punch, soft heavy and short generic impact candidates.
- Sci-fi Sounds: small laser, crunch explosion, force field (alternate candidate).
- Digital Audio: phase jump, rising phaser, descending low tone.
- Particle Pack: electric spark, light ring, muzzle flash (transparent PNG).
- City Kit Industrial 2.0: selected buildings, chimney, container and original color atlas; original license retained in Industrial/License.txt.

Audio selection is an initial filename-based pass, pending user listening and feel review.
Unused candidate clips stay available for quick comparison; the full packs were not imported.
